metadata.question: Does the wind push ash from Sakurajima first east then south, rathar than first south then east after an eruption on May 21, 2015?

data.raw_code: 1. Masking strategy: - Do NOT mask clouds - we're looking for ash plumes which appear similar to clouds - Use aerosol bands or true color to identify ash direction - Need temporal sequence: immediate post-eruption, then hours/day later 3. import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# Sakurajima volcano location
volcano = ee.Geometry.Point([130.66, 31.58])

# Define regions to check ash presence (east and south of volcano)
east_region = ee.Geometry.Rectangle([130.8, 31.48, 131.2, 31.68])  # East
south_region = ee.Geometry.Rectangle([130.56, 31.2, 130.76, 31.48])  # South

# Get MODIS Terra imagery for aerosol detection (better temporal resolution)
# May 21, 2015 and immediate days after
early_period = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MOD09GA') \
    .filterBounds(volcano) \
    .filterDate('2015-05-21', '2015-05-22') \
    .select(['sur_refl_b01', 'sur_refl_b04'])

later_period = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MOD09GA') \
    .filterBounds(volcano) \
    .filterDate('2015-05-22', '2015-05-24') \
    .select(['sur_refl_b01', 'sur_refl_b04'])

print(f"Early images (May 21-22): {early_period.size().getInfo()}")
print(f"Later images (May 22-24): {later_period.size().getInfo()}")

if early_period.size().getInfo() == 0 or later_period.size().getInfo() == 0:
    # Try Landsat 8 as fallback
    early_period = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2') \
        .filterBounds(volcano) \
        .filterDate('2015-05-21', '2015-05-23')
    
    later_period = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2') \
        .filterBounds(volcano) \
        .filterDate('2015-05-23', '2015-05-26')
    
    print(f"Landsat early: {early_period.size().getInfo()}")
    print(f"Landsat later: {later_period.size().getInfo()}")
    
    if early_period.size().getInfo() == 0 or later_period.size().getInfo() == 0:
        print("No imagery available for tracking ash plume")
        print("<answer>C1</answer>")
    else:
        print("Insufficient temporal resolution to track ash direction")
        print("<answer>C1</answer>")
else:
    # Calculate aerosol/brightness in east and south regions for early period
    early_img = early_period.first()
    
    east_early = early_img.reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(),
        geometry=east_region,
        scale=5000,
        maxPixels=1e9
    ).get('sur_refl_b01').getInfo()
    
    south_early = early_img.reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(),
        geometry=south_region,
        scale=5000,
        maxPixels=1e9
    ).get('sur_refl_b01').getInfo()
    
    # Calculate for later period
    later_img = later_period.first()
    
    east_later = later_img.reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(),
        geometry=east_region,
        scale=5000,
        maxPixels=1e9
    ).get('sur_refl_b01').getInfo()
    
    south_later = later_img.reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(),
        geometry=south_region,
        scale=5000,
        maxPixels=1e9
    ).get('sur_refl_b01').getInfo()
    
    if any(v is None for v in [east_early, south_early, east_later, south_later]):
        print("Failed to calculate ash reflectance")
        print("<answer>C3</answer>")
    else:
        print(f"Early: East={east_early:.3f}, South={south_early:.3f}")
        print(f"Later: East={east_later:.3f}, South={south_later:.3f}")
        
        # Check if ash went east first (higher early east value) then south (higher later south value)
        east_first = east_early > south_early
        south_later_increase = south_later > south_early
        
        if east_first and south_later_increase:
            print("Ash direction: East then South")
            print("<answer>A</answer>")
        else:
            print("Ash direction: Not East-then-South pattern")
            print("<answer>B</answer>")
